summary: Keep retired claims' operation receipts and ancestry in ledgers that only grow

replay.detail: No replay. After the retired-identity import finishes, the same background job unions existing checkpoint_claims rows into the operation-receipt and ancestry ledgers, 4,096 rows per writer transaction with its own committed cursor.

schema.detail: Adds WITHOUT ROWID tables retired_operation_receipts(operation_id, request_digest, claim_id) and retired_claim_ancestry(claim_id, subject, kind, predecessors), the index retired_claim_ancestry_subject(subject, kind), and three triggers on checkpoint_claims (AFTER INSERT, AFTER UPDATE, BEFORE DELETE). Storage version stays 20. Ancestry rows copy each dropped claim's subject, kind and predecessor JSON, so their size follows those columns of checkpoint_claims; no measurement was taken.

rules.detail: Retries, conflict detection, ancestry walks, seat history, manifests and digests still read checkpoint_claims. Nothing reads the new ledgers yet.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client or backup format change. A restore rebuilds these ledgers from the restored tombstones through the triggers.

downtime.detail: Normal restart; tables, index and triggers are created empty at open. The import runs after startup on the writer queue.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an earlier binary is supported; the ledgers and triggers remain and nothing depends on them.
